tools.name: lookup_tcm_acupoints_and_tuina
tools.description: Look up Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) Tuina massage modalities, blind massage (Mangren Anmo) clinical norms, meridian acupoints (e.g. LI4 Hegu, GB20 Fengchi, ST36 Zusanli), and bilingual Mandarin/Pinyin phrases for travelers in China.
